event.title: Trump Claims US Has Permanent Security Control Over Greenland Following Denmark Deal
event.canonical_title: Trump Claims US Has Permanent Security Control Over Greenland Following Denmark Deal
event.summary: President Trump announced a new agreement with Denmark that he claims grants the United States 'permanent control over security' in Greenland. This deal follows Trump's previous assertions about increasing US influence over the territory, which he had suggested could include outright ownership. While the agreement has been welcomed by Denmark and NATO, there are concerns among Greenlanders regarding the implications for their sovereignty and security.
